name: qf_v8
character: A black V8 car behind and beside the camera: an uneven firing pulse (rpm x 8 / 120) through a big exhaust, its pitch following the rpm through six gears, a lope at idle, a burble on every downshift and the whole body heavier than the bike.
note: f0 is the firing frequency rpm x 8 / 120 (46.7 Hz at 700 rpm idle, 433 Hz at the 6500 limit); the pitch curve is rpm / idle rpm through timeline.villain_car, a shift multiplies the rpm by the ratio of the new gear to the old. ESTIMATE: gear ratios, formants and every level are starting values; no recording of a car was analysed
